name: Like Seafoam
source:
Once upon a time, a mermaid fell in love with a human prince. When his ship was lost in a storm, she brought him to the nearest shore. But when the prince opened his eyes, he saw another girl, and believed she to be his savior.

This other woman, Viola, has no interest in marrying this man. But nobility means obligation and duty, and so she's resigned to a loveless marriage to a man she wishes she'd never met.

But Prince Edvard has brought a mute woman named Pearl along with him... a mute woman who seems ethereal, unlike anyone Viola has ever met before. 

[From [url=https://krispycat.itch.io/like-seafoam]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
从前，一条美人鱼爱上了一位人类王子。当他的船在暴风雨中迷失时，她把他带到了最近的海岸。但当王子睁开眼睛时，他看到了另一个女孩，并相信她是他的救世主。

另一个女人，维奥拉，没有兴趣嫁给这个男人。但高贵意味着义务和责任，因此她甘愿与一个她希望从未见过的男人进行无爱的婚姻。

但爱德华王子却带来了一个名叫珀尔的哑女……这个哑女看起来很飘逸，不像维奥拉以前见过的任何人。

[来自[url=https://krispycat.itch.io/like-seafoam]Itch.io[/url]]
